name: 背景安定性分析
description: Analyzes background region stability in video frames.
useCase: Detecting AI videos through unnatural background patterns
mechanism: Compares texture variation between peripheral background regions and central foreground. AI-generated videos often produce unnaturally stable or warping backgrounds.
source: Durall et al. (2020) - Watch Your Up-Convolution, CVPR Workshop
algorithm: Edge vs Center Variance Ratio Analysis
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Durall et al. (2020) - Watch Your Up-Convolution, CVPR Workshop
Li, L. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Zhao, H. et al. (2021). Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection. CVPR.
